title: Sim-to-Real Transfer for Muscle-Actuated Robots via Generalized Actuator Networks
abstract: arXiv:2604.09487v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tendon drives paired with soft muscle actuation enable faster and safer robots while potentially accelerating skill acquisition. Still, these systems are rarely used in practice due to inherent nonlinearities, friction, and hysteresis, which complicate modeling and control. So far, these challenges have hindered policy transfer from simulation to real systems. To bridge this gap, we propose a sim-to-real pipeline that learns a neural network model of this complex actuation and leverages established rigid body simulation for the arm dynamics and interactions with the environment. Our method, called Generalized Actuator Network (GenAN), enables actuation model identification across a wide range of robots by learning directly from joint position trajectories rather than requiring torque sensors. translated_title: 通过广义执行器网络实现肌肉驱动机器人的仿真到真实迁移
translated_abstract: 肌腱驱动配合软体肌肉驱动能够实现更快、更安全的机器人，并有望加速技能习得。然而，由于固有的非线性、摩擦和迟滞特性使建模和控制变得复杂，这类系统在实践中很少被使用。迄今为止，这些挑战一直阻碍着策略从仿真到真实系统的迁移。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一个仿真到真实的流程：学习一个神经网络模型来刻画这种复杂的驱动方式，同时利用成熟的刚体仿真来处理手臂动力学及与环境的交互。我们的方法称为广义执行器网络，通过直接从关节位置轨迹中学习，而无需扭矩传感器，即可实现对多种机器人的驱动模型识别。我们将GenAN应用于PAMY2——一种由气动人工肌肉驱动的肌腱驱动机器人，成功部署了动态且精确的目标……
tldr: 提出广义执行器网络（GenAN），无需扭矩传感器、仅从关节位置轨迹即可学习气动人工肌肉等复杂驱动系统的神经模型，实现了肌肉驱动机器人动态精确技能从仿真到真实系统的迁移。
en_tdlr: The proposed Generalized Actuator Network (GenAN) learns neural actuation models directly from joint position trajectories without torque sensors, enabling sim-to-real transfer of dynamic, precise skills for muscle-actuated robots such as the tendon-driven PAMY2.
